title: How to restart the service on watch
symptom: After turning off and on the watch, xDrip does not work as a standalone collector. The user cannot restart the service; only disabling and re-enabling the smartwatch from the phone works, but the user does not have an Android phone available.
evidence_quote: I turned on an off the bluetooth and/or restarted the watch, and I was not able to have it working any more. I hit "database refresh and restart collector" and rebooted the watch, but it is still not working.
